default_in_force_rule.text: Not applied as a general rule: every version is dated by the vigência clause of the law that made it. Lei n.º 18/21, art. 6.º: "A presente Lei de Revisão Constitucional entra em vigor à data da sua publicação" (Diário da República, I Série, n.º 154, 16 August 2021). Leis n.º 38/20 and 39/20: in force ninety days after publication (Diário da República, I Série, n.º 179, 11 November 2020), that is 9 February 2021.

country.licence_note: Texts: Diário da República de Angola (Imprensa Nacional), I Série, n.º 154 of 16 August 2021 (Lei n.º 18/21 and the republished Constitution) and n.º 179 of 11 November 2020 (Leis n.º 38/20 and 39/20), as published on the Government of Angola's legislation portal (governo.gov.ao, files on plataformacipra.gov.ao). Official texts of the Republic of Angola.

versions.note: The republication ordered by Lei n.º 18/21, art. 4.º (Diário da República, I Série, n.º 154, 16 August 2021): the Constitution of 2010 with the 2021 revision's changes, additions and repeals. In force on publication (Lei n.º 18/21, art. 6.º). The Gazette's footnotes, which mark each provision "Alterado", "Aditado" or "Revogado pelo artigo 1.º/2.º/3.º da Lei n.º 18/21", are left out of the text.

sources.notes: Born-digital (Adobe InDesign) PDF, 48 pages, linked from https://governo.gov.ao/documentos/constituição: Lei n.º 18/21 and the full republication of the Constitution it orders (art. 4.º). Read from its text layer.

sources.name: Tribunal Constitucional de Angola, Constituição da República de Angola, Edição Especial Actualizada (2022)
sources.licence: Official edition of the Tribunal Constitucional; no licence stated.
sources.notes: InDesign PDF with a text layer (January 2022). Used only to cross-check the republication word by word; no text is taken from it.

decisions: Acts: the Constitution (published here), the Código Penal and the Código do Processo Penal (built, but held back from main). Lei n.º 22/11 (data protection) is published by the APD only as image scans: left out (no OCR).

The Constitution has one version, 2021-08-16: the official republication ordered by Lei n.º 18/21 (art. 4.º), in force on publication (art. 6.º). It is credited to the publisher as the oldest version available, naming the Constitution of 2010 and Lei n.º 18/21. A 2010 version cannot be built: the Diário da República of 5 February 2010 is available only as a scan (no OCR), and Lei n.º 18/21 prints only the new wording of the provisions it changes ("1. […]" for kept paragraphs), so the 2010 wording of the altered provisions is not available as text.

Cross-check: every article, the preamble, the three annexes and the approval formula were compared word for word with the Tribunal Constitucional's Edição Especial Actualizada (2022). They agree apart from five differences between the two editions, where the Diário da República's wording is kept: art. 36.º, n.º 3 lists the last item as "f)" (TC "e)"); art. 42.º, n.º 3, a) "proteção" (TC "protecção"); art. 173.º, n.º 1 "A requerimento do Presidente da Republica" (TC "O requerimento do Presidente da República"); art. 174.º, n.º 4 "extra-judicial" (TC "extrajudicial"); art. 242.º, n.º 2 "esetabelece" (TC "estabelece"). Article titles are in sentence case in the Gazette and in title case in the TC edition. Four words split across lines in the TC edition (arts. 16, 83, 95, 96) are artefacts of its text layer.

Footnotes and their markers (7 pt and smaller) are left out; ordinal superscripts after body text ("n.os", "2.os") are kept. Line-end soft hyphens are joined; a hard hyphen at a line end is joined without the hyphen only when the whole word is printed elsewhere in the same Gazette, otherwise kept.

Unit layout: one file per article (art-NNN, art-NNN-a for the articles added with a letter), the preamble, the three annexes and the approval formula; title, chapter and section headings are gathered in one file, estrutura, which names the article each heading precedes. The list of constituent legislators printed after the annexes is not law text and is left out.
Typesetting is normalised once: NBSP to space, en dash to em dash, curly double quotes to « », the curly apostrophe to a straight one, runs of spaces collapsed.
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote fetch.py and parse.py, chose the sources and wrote the decisions. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py is deterministic code over the cached PDFs.

versions.note: The Code as enacted by Lei n.º 38/20 (Diário da República, I Série, n.º 179, 11 November 2020), in force ninety days after publication (art. 9.º of the approving law); the Tribunal Supremo (Acórdão, Proc. n.º 6089/21) states it "entrou em vigor a 9 de Fevereiro de 2021". Later amendments (Lei n.º 12/24) are not applied: no text of them with a text layer was found.

decisions: Código Penal: one version, 2021-02-09, the Code as enacted by Lei n.º 38/20, credited to that law. It is held back from main (no corpus.d PUBLISH): Lei n.º 12/24, de 4 de Julho, amended the Code, and no copy of it with a text layer was found, so today's text cannot be shown to equal the official text.

versions.note: The Code as enacted by Lei n.º 39/20 (Diário da República, I Série, n.º 179, 11 November 2020), in force 90 days after publication (the approving law's own clause).

lei-39-20.title: Lei n.º 39/20, de 11 de Novembro — Aprova o Código do Processo Penal Angolano

decisions: Código do Processo Penal: one version, 2021-02-09, the Code as enacted by Lei n.º 39/20 (same Gazette and the same 90-day clause as the Código Penal), credited to that law. It is held back from main: later amendments were not researched, so today's text is not verified. Four of its article headings print a degree sign ("ARTIGO 534.°") for the ordinal indicator; both are read.
